product.title: The Cooking of China Emily Hahn 1971 Time Life Hardcover Recipe Book Slipcase
product.description:
The Cooking of China — Emily Hahn

Emily Hahn's illustrated exploration of Chinese food and cooking, from Time-Life's Foods of the World series, accompanied by the spiral-bound recipe booklet and matching slipcase.

Condition

Good used vintage condition with visible wear. Slipcase shows spotting, discoloration, scuffs, edge rubbing and worn corners. The recipe booklet has cover marks and corner creasing/wear. The photographed interior pages appear readable; neither volume has been inspected page by page. Please review all photographs.

Details

  • Emily Hahn and the Editors of Time-Life Books
  • Foods of the World series; photographed by Michael Rougier
  • Hardcover copyright 1968; revised 1971 as printed in the book. Recipe booklet printing not confirmed.
  • English language; hardcover and spiral-bound recipe booklet
  • Approximate set dimensions: 11 × 8½ × 1¼ inches; estimated, not individually measured

Included

One hardcover, one companion spiral-bound recipe booklet and the matching illustrated slipcase shown.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner and edge protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
